purpose: Describe the stateless boundary between observed content performance and the central Maison learning architecture.

lineage.source_refs_hash: SHA-256 of ordered canonical Brain/source references
lineage.human_review_ref: reference to the approval that permitted manual distribution
lineage.campaign_id: derived Content OS campaign identifier; optional
lineage.thesis_id: derived thesis identifier tied to hashed canonical source lineage; optional
lineage.variant_key: variant lineage within a comparison; optional

downstream_mapping_required.reason: A11 currently supports decision, experiment, journey, conversion and promotion source kinds; changing that is central learning architecture.
downstream_mapping_required.expected_behavior: Central Brain may map A1 content.performance_observed into bounded, append-only learning using its own governed contract.
